class.name: VECSNetworkSync
class.brief_description: Central network coordinator: binds a world to a sync strategy and exposes the RPC transport.
class.description:
[b]VECSNetworkSync[/b] connects one [VECSWorld] to a [VECSSyncStrategy] (default: [VECSSnapshotReplication]) and drives replication. On the server, call [method tick] each frame; the strategy spawns networked entities, pushes dirty fields as deltas, despawns destroyed entities and periodically broadcasts a full state for reconciliation.
Transport is Godot's MultiplayerAPI (RPC); for testing, connect two nodes with [method set_direct_peer] to deliver packets in-process without a network.

method.name: bind_world
method.description: Binds this sync node to [param world]. Registers an observer that forwards component events to the strategy and seeds the strategy from the current world contents.

method.name: get_direct_peer
method.description: Returns the in-process peer set with [method set_direct_peer].

method.name: get_session_id
method.description: Returns the current replication session id. Packets carrying an older session id are ignored.

method.name: is_server
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this node is configured as the authoritative server.

method.name: request_full_state
method.description: Immediately broadcasts a full-state snapshot to every connected peer (reconciliation).

method.name: reset
method.description: Unregisters the world observer and resets the strategy's tracked state.

method.name: set_direct_peer
method.description: Sets an in-process peer for testing: packets are delivered directly to [param peer] instead of going through the RPC layer.

method.name: set_server
method.description: Sets whether this node acts as the authoritative server.

method.name: set_session_id
method.description: Sets the replication session id; packets from older sessions are dropped.

method.name: set_strategy
method.description: Swaps in a custom [VECSSyncStrategy] implementation. The new strategy is seeded from the current world.

method.name: tick
method.description: Drives the strategy once per frame with [param delta] seconds. On the server this sends spawns, deltas, despawns and periodic reconciliations.
